== Title ==
<span lang="ja">予期せぬ損傷</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">敵のキャラクターが2名以上、武器が1つ以上配備されている位置での戦闘の開始時に、事故が起こる。運命数を引く。運命数＜その位置の敵キャラクターの人数ならば、その中の1名がロストする（ロストするキャラクターは、敵プレイヤーが選ぶ）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ブラスト ベストとブラスト シールド付きヘルメットで完全武装の反乱軍兵士も、手榴弾が弾け パネルが爆発する戦場では、無事ではいられない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Collateral Damage]].

'''Lore''' — Even Rebel soldiers fully armed with blast vests and blast-shield helmets cannot stay unharmed on a battlefield where grenades burst and panels explode.

'''Game text''' — An accident occurs at the start of a battle at a location where two or more opposing characters and one or more weapons are deployed. Draw destiny. If destiny < the number of opposing characters at that location, one is lost (the opposing player chooses).

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese uses 位置 with deployed opposing characters and weapons. English uses a site where the opponent has at least two characters and one weapon.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-collateraldamage.gif|Original English face]], [[Collateral Damage]].</ref>
